name: a heading derives its id: code spans go, punctuation goes, whitespace runs become one hyphen
a derived id carries no diacritics: NFD splits them off and step 4 deletes the marks
a script that writes no combining marks is untouched
a mark with no precomposed form is deleted like any other: İ lower-cases to i + U+0307
the id does not depend on the normalization form the text was written in
two headings that differ only in their diacritics collide
underscores survive, so foo_bar and foobar are two ids
a double-backtick code span is a code span: its content goes too
a code span is recognised by run length, so a shorter run inside it is content
an escaped backtick opens no code span, so the letters between stay
an unmatched backtick run opens no code span
a backtick inside inline math opens no code span; the code span after it still goes
a number is any character of General Category N, not only a decimal digit
geml: ## Step ² and ½ and Ⅳ
want: h2("Step ² and ½ and Ⅳ")

name: whitespace is the White_Space property: a no-break space separates
whitespace is the White_Space property: NEL separates
whitespace is the White_Space property: U+FEFF is not in it, so it is deleted
an ideographic space separates
a heading with no letter and no number derives the empty string, which is no id
two headings that derive nothing do not collide: neither has an id
an attribute object writing `#` alone reads as if no id were written: a block has none, a heading derives one
the id is derived before interpolation, so a meta value cannot move it
an explicit id replaces the derived one
